# SOP-P1-L3-04 Shift handover - Machining line

Revision: Rev D  
Plant: P1, line P1-L3  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L3-IH01, EQ-P1-L3-HP02, EQ-P1-L3-CN03

Purpose: Ensure safe, continuous operation and complete information transfer between shifts for Machining line P1-L3.

Preconditions
1. Incoming operator has read the previous shift notes and local alarms cleared.
2. All equipment listed in this document is available and tags match equipment registry.
3. Confirm consumables and tool status referenced to MM-P1-L3-IH01.

Personal protective equipment (PPE)
1. Safety glasses.
2. Cut-resistant gloves.
3. Hearing protection.
4. Steel-toe footwear.

Procedure (numbered steps)
1. Visual inspection: Walk the line and note any leaks, damage, or abnormal indications at EQ-P1-L3-IH01, EQ-P1-L3-HP02, EQ-P1-L3-CN03. Record findings in the shift log.
2. Process status: Verify cycle state, part counts, and active work orders on the line controller. Escalate discrepancies per QS-PROC-04.
3. EQ-P1-L3-IH01 specific: Confirm target billet temperature for Machining induction billet heater #1 (EQ-P1-L3-IH01) is 1235 °C and that the last recorded temperature profile matches the active work order.
4. EQ-P1-L3-HP02 specific: Confirm hydraulic system pressure normality and that the lubricant part number for Machining hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L3-HP02) is CFW-LUB-497. Log lubricant batch and install location if changed.
5. Tooling and conveyors: Check cutter condition and conveyor alignment at EQ-P1-L3-CN03. Record any tool change actions in the log.
6. Quality holds and non-conforming parts: Isolate and tag per QS-PROC-04; notify quality on call as required.
7. Maintenance items: Communicate any open maintenance requests per MM-P1-L3-IH01 and include notes for ECN-2026-008 if engineering change actions are required.

Handover communication
1. Outgoing operator briefs incoming operator on items 1–7, outstanding actions, and any safety risks.
2. Both operators review the shift log entries and initial the log entry for the handover.

Sign-off
1. Outgoing operator name / signature:
2. Incoming operator name / signature:
3. Supervisor name / signature:

References
- ECN-2026-008
- MM-P1-L3-IH01
- QS-PROC-04
